decision: MANUAL REFERENCE-CONSTRAINED RECONSTRUCTION HAS REACHED ITS RELIABLE LIMIT.
scope: Current mixed reference library and this manual workflow, not proof that NURBS or manual reconstruction is intrinsically impossible.
positive_evidence: 16-point editable bicubic surface has smooth broad curvature
front taper/base improved after one control-row correction
remaining_problems: Four-sided perimeter remains too rectilinear at corners and lower boundary versus the reference glass.
Side rake is broadly plausible, but cowl/header endpoint positions and transverse corner falloff are not convincingly established together.
Three-quarter foreshortening/perimeter correspondence remains approximate; manually posed views are not accepted camera matches.
next_practical_options: controlled same-vehicle capture suitable for reconstruction
